message: I'm interested in the T45 Utility, tractor only, no add-ons. My budget is $33,000. Can you do that?

Thanks for your interest in the T45 Utility. It's a great fit for 10-50 acres, with 45 hp, 4WD, a Cat I/II 3-point hitch, and a 540 PTO. $33,000 is more than we can do on this model, but I'd like to work with you. I can offer the T45, tractor only, for $40,000. If your budget is firm, the T25 Compact might also be worth a look, depending on your acreage and how you'll use it.
The T25 won't handle a 6-foot rotary mower on 40 acres, so it has to be the T45. Heartland posts the T45 at $40,750, but my budget is $34,000 and I can pay in full today. Can you get to $34,000?

Understood, the T45 is the right machine for a 6-foot rotary mower on 40 acres. I appreciate that you can pay in full today. $34,000 is still below what I can do on this tractor, but I'll move toward you: the T45 Utility, tractor only, for $38,500. If you'd like delivery and setup within 150 miles included, I can also put together a package price.
I appreciate the movement. I can stretch to $34,500 for the T45, tractor only, and buy right now.

Thanks for stretching, and I appreciate that you're ready to buy today. $34,500 is still below what I can do on the T45, but I'll meet you partway again: the T45 Utility, tractor only, for $37,500, payable in full at checkout. It's a strong price for a machine that will handle your 6-foot rotary mower on 40 acres for years.
$35,000 for the T45 tractor only is my final number. If you can do that, I'll check out immediately; otherwise I'll have to pass.

I appreciate your directness and that you're ready to check out today. $35,000 is below what I can do on the T45, so I can't accept it. I don't want to lose this deal over a gap we can close, so here is my best number: the T45 Utility, tractor only, for $36,500, payable in full at checkout. That's $5,500 off list, and I can't go any lower on this machine. If it works for you, you can check out right away.
I understand. I truly can't go above $35,400 for the T45 tractor only. That's my absolute limit — if you can't meet it, I'll have to walk.

I respect that $35,400 is your limit, and I wish I could meet it. $36,500 for the T45 Utility, tractor only, is the lowest I can go, and I can't go under it. That's $5,500 off list, payable in full at checkout. The offer stands if you can find the extra $1,100, and you can check out right away.
